entry.author: Ruapehu District Council
entry.summary:
Flooding swept through Ohura township in the early hours of Sunday morning 19 April 2026 requiring some whanau to escape to safety through chest high water. 

The next day the NZDF flew Ruapehu Mayor Weston Kirton, Emergency Management Minister Mark Mitchell, and elected representatives and staff from Horizons Regional Council over the flooded river catchment before landing in the township to meet with impacted residents.

This video shows the flyover of the river catchment.
